proposals.title: Streamline optimization proposal tracking
proposals.rationale: Proposals should carry measured before/after evidence when approved.

proposals.title: Promote verified architecture recommendations to ADRs
proposals.rationale: Verified ARC recommendations should become decision records.

proposals.title: Schedule high-severity debt for refactoring
proposals.rationale: Highest-severity debt records should feed the next refactoring mission.

proposals.title: Apply verified resource recommendations to infrastructure
proposals.rationale: Resource savings should be measured against the baseline after change.

proposals.title: Automate bottleneck re-detection in CI
proposals.rationale: Run bottleneck detection on the CI and record findings in the registry.

proposals.title: Feed optimization results back to the Learner
proposals.rationale: Every verified optimization should become reusable engineering knowledge.

proposals.title: Publish optimization knowledge to the knowledge store
proposals.rationale: Optimization lessons should be searchable alongside mission lessons.
